artworks.title: Michel Lepelletier
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner (printed in blue, red, yellow, and black inks)
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 35.3 x 28 cm (13 7/8 x 11 in.)
overall (framing line): 24.6 x 21.8 cm (9 11/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned slightly at an angle, looking to his left. He has mature facial features with a prominent nose and lips. His hair is gray and styled in a voluminous manner, extending back from his forehead. He is wearing a dark-colored coat with a high collar, and underneath, a pink waistcoat is visible. Around his neck, he has a large, intricately tied white cravat. There is no jewelry visible or objects in his hands. The portrait is set against an oval, mottled dark brown background, framed with his name, Michel Lepelletier, inscribed below.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Penitent
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 10.7 x 8.5 cm (4 3/16 x 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated figure against a rocky surface. The person has an aged appearance with prominent facial features, a long beard, and curly hair that thins towards the top of the head. The figure's shoulders and arms are bare, while a draped fabric covers the waist and lower body. In one hand, the person holds a large crucifix or cross-like object. In the scene with the figure is an open book and a human skull, lying near each other at the bottom right corner. The background consists of rough and textured rock formations, suggesting a cave-like setting.

artworks.title: Mucius Scaevola
artworks.medium: sepia ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene indoors with dynamic figures. The drawing depicts an interior setting with elaborate drapery hanging from the ceiling. The figures are engaged in discussion or confrontation, gesturing animatedly. A central table is present in the scene, cluttered with various objects. On the floor, there are two figures lying down. The use of shading and intricate linework adds depth to the piece.

artworks.title: Horses
artworks.artist: French 19th Century (Possibly Alexandre-Gabriel Decamps) after Paulus Potter
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two horses standing together. The drawing depicts two horses rendered in charcoal or pencil on a piece of paper. One horse faces the viewer with its head turned slightly, while the other faces away, showing only its hindquarters. The texture and shadowing capture the physique of the animals, emphasizing their rounded forms and muscular bodies with swift strokes. In the sky behind them is a suggestion of clouds sketched with similar lines. The paper has visible wear and a few tears on the edges.

artworks.title: Rider in the Countryside
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on brown paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a low horizon view of an open landscape. The sketch features loose brushstrokes with visible pencil or charcoal lines outlining trees, figures, and animals. The color palette is muted, with earthy browns and greys dominating. In the foreground, there are vegetation and undefined shapes. Further back, a figure rides a horse, accompanied by two other animals. The background shows sketched silhouettes of trees.

artworks.title: Pêcheur en Canot, au bord d'une Rivière (Fisherman in a Boat)
artworks.medium: etching with monoprint inking on China paper
artworks.description: The image shows a calm, narrow river bordered by dense trees. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the scene. Tall trees and grazing animals are silhouetted against the sky. The style appears to be fine etching, with delicate lines creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly shades of gray and black. In the foreground, a figure sits in a rowboat, framed by reeds. On the opposite bank, there are figures and animals in the misty distance.

artworks.title: Carew Castle, Pembrokeshire
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a castle in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly upward, with the castle silhouetted against the sky. The painting uses fluid brushwork and sepia tones, creating a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. Trees with dense foliage frame the left side, the ground is subtly undulating, and hills are visible in the background. Wispy clouds are dispersed in the sky, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle ruin on a hill, a horizon line, hills, sky, a body of water, and silhouetted branches. The artwork uses a sepia color palette with a variety of tones. The brushstrokes are soft and broad, creating smoothness and blending. There are two figures near the water, birds in the sky, and a sense of scale and vastness.

artworks.title: Farmyard
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with various buildings and a large tree in the center. The painting features loose and fluid brushstrokes, with an earthy color palette dominated by browns and greens. In the distance, thatched-roof cottages surround the central tree, with a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Village sur le bord d'une Riviere
artworks.medium: etching with roulette work on chine collé
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape with buildings, a figure walking on a path, a body of water, and a barren tree in the foreground. The horizon shows a series of houses under expressive, cloudy skies. The color scheme is grayscale, highlighting the sky-land contrast, with a sketch-like style using bold, linear strokes.

artworks.title: Lovers Embracing
artworks.medium: brown ink and brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features sharp, angled lines and shaded areas forming an abstract composition. Bold, dark lines intersect and overlap, creating an impression of jagged rocks or angular forms. The arrangement of shapes is open to interpretation, possibly resembling a human figure or draped fabric. The overall pattern of lines and shading creates a dynamic, textured effect on the neutral-toned paper.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with a River
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 8 x 12 cm (3 1/8 x 4 3/4 in.)
sheet: 9.7 x 12.7 cm (3 13/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly lower perspective, showing a landscape with large trees on the right side and a body of water on the left. There are intricate and detailed brushstrokes depicting the lush trees. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and sepia on a cream background. The composition is balanced with dense foliage in the foreground transitioning to open spaces and lighter vegetation in the distance.

artworks.title: Saint Mark Writing His Gospels
artworks.artist: Giulio Bonasone after Perino del Vaga
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting on a stone bench with a book or tablet in one hand, appearing to be reading. The individual has short curly hair, a beard, and a mustache, and is wearing flowing robes. A winged lion is positioned to the right of the person, with an architectural setting in the background.

artworks.title: Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Pieter Claesz Soutman
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. He has prominent facial features with a high forehead, deep-set eyes, a long nose, and a full beard. He wears a cap over his hair and a collared garment that seems like a cloak over a shirt. The oval frame around the portrait is ornate with cherubic figures, fruits, and drapery. Cherubic figures at the top hold a wreath and a crest inscribed "EER BOVEN GOLT." Additional cherubic figures and a scroll with a Latin inscription are at the bottom of the frame. The background is abstract and textured.

artworks.title: Summit of Mont Titlis, Switzerland
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy mountain landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the frame, displaying rugged peaks under a clear sky. Several figures are on the snow-covered slope, dressed for a mountaineering expedition. A small peak with a rocky pinnacle is prominent near the center-right, with footprints on its surface. The color palette features sepia tones, giving a vintage quality. The sky blends into the snow and mountain shadows. The figures and equipment provide scale to the landscape.

artworks.title: Riverbank
artworks.creditLine: The Amy Rose Silverman Fund and Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape featuring a calm water body with a fallen tree creating a bridge-like form. A rocky cliff dominates the background, with tall trees on the right side partially blocking the sky. The overall color palette is warm, in sepia tones, creating a vintage atmosphere. The reflection of the surroundings is visible in the water, with soft textures and tones blending harmoniously.

artworks.title: Marais de Fampoux
artworks.creditLine: The Richard and Judith Smooke Fund and Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a lakeside scene with a tree leaning over reeds and foliage by the water's edge. The horizon line is visible in the upper third, with trees in the distance. The water appears calm and reflective, with more reeds emerging. The color palette is subdued and sepia, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Kalaat-El Hosn, deuxième enceinte, extérieur, midi
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient stone castle wall viewed from a slightly upward angle. The structure is massive, with vertical stone walls featuring crenelations. The textured, aged stones are depicted in a monochromatic sepia palette. In the foreground, large, well-fitted stones are visible, along with a cylindrical tower. Vegetation grows from some crevices, and a distant tree is silhouetted against the sky.

artworks.title: A Vanitas
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a young man from the waist up, seated at a small round table. He faces the camera directly, has short dark hair, a full beard and mustache, and wears a checkered suit jacket over a waistcoat with a white shirt. He is holding a human skull in his right hand, which rests on the table covered in a patterned cloth. His left hand is placed on the skull. The background appears blurred, suggesting an outdoor setting with foliage.

artworks.title: Girl with a Pitcher
artworks.medium: pen lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a young person from head to toe. The figure is standing in a leaning pose, with one arm on a large rock or tree branch and the other hand holding a hat. They have delicate features, medium-length wavy hair, and wear a long dress with rolled-up sleeves. The background includes trees, foliage, and a distant building resembling a church or castle with a steeple. The setting suggests a rural or pastoral environment, with detailed lines emphasizing texture and form.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with Shadowed Face, Wearing a Scarf and a Plumed Hat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul S. Morgan
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person, mainly focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is positioned facing forward, with their face turned slightly toward the left. Their facial features are partially obscured by a dense and textured hat with fluffy edges. The hair seems voluminous and curly. The person wears fabric draping around their shoulders, adding to the texture. No jewelry or objects in the hands are visible. The background features sparse, sketch-like lines that could represent foliage or a natural setting.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with Two Men Resting
artworks.medium: etching in red-brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape captured from an elevated perspective. Two figures are seated beneath a tree on the left side of the scene. A body of water, hills, cliffs, and a village with buildings and a tower can be seen in the distance. The sky is filled with clouds, and the artwork is rendered in sepia tones. Detailed etching and stippling techniques are used to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Head of a Moor Bending Forward
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body, including their head, shoulders, and arms. The person is leaning forward with their head bowed and turned to the side, looking down. Their hair is short and curly, and their facial features are partially visible from a top-down angle. The person is wearing a garment with a striped pattern around the neckline and fur-like texture on the shoulders. A piece of fabric with a geometric pattern is also visible. The background has a textured pattern, with no discernible objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of a Monumental Port
artworks.artist: Carl Wilhelm Weisbrod after Hubert Robert
artworks.description: The image features a stone archway with people on top and a sculpted figure above them. In the background, there is another large arch framing the sky and a boat on the water. The illustration has intricate linework depicting textures and human figures. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of brown and sepia. People are depicted engaging in various activities on a path with ornate buildings in the distance.
